capabilities: Create and manage books, volumes and chapters as Markdown files
Run six-stage automatic book generation from a one-line premise
Write, continue, rewrite, polish and de-AI chapters via LLM
Detect sensitive words and typos, count words and log typing stats
Show relationship graph, timeline and scene canvas panels
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat plugin; it is a novel-writing pipeline that keeps books and chapters as plain Markdown in a work folder.
extras: README includes a long security disclosure about network calls, base64 use and vault enumeration; the old WRITING_GUIDE.md system was retired in v0.3.5+ and its files are auto-purged. Desktop and mobile supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for long-form fiction, so managing manuscripts, outlines and AI writing stages across many files is manual work.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (local server or provider API)
Provider API key for hosted endpoints

summary: AI novel-writing toolkit that manages books, volumes and chapters as vault Markdown and runs a six-stage LLM generation pipeline.
